description: Compact selection from the same English fixture for the sections overview. This manifest is not a public component API.

sectionOverrides.title: Morgenhafen at a glance
sectionOverrides.headline: What takes shape together.
sectionOverrides.introduction: A selection from the entirely fictional story of the Morgenhafen urban lab: ongoing projects, shared activities and seven publications on the same day.

adapterRules: Resolve eventKeys against the canonical source using the (categoryId, eventId) pair; retain category order.
Clone the selected English data without mutating the canonical source.
Apply sectionOverrides; preserve original event dates even when an event begins before section.start.
Rewrite the source-section action anchor #morgenhafen-timeline to the actual instance ID.
Do not add section.end: existing ongoing-event semantics would let it override referenceDate.
Apply the existing application base path to local asset URLs using the established helper.
